title: Fabulous Looks, But Overall Poor Design
text:
Fabulous Looks, But Overall Poor Design. This MR.COFFEE 12-CUP PROGRAMMABLE COFFEEMAKER, STAINLESS STEEL looks fabulous, brews fast, has easy-to-use buttons, includes a water filtration system, has a keep-warm plate, and includes a cleaning cycle setting. Unfortunately, the coffeemaker also has a hard-to-fill reservoir, a clumsy "removable filter basket", and an exposed showerhead-type water system that emits steam when the lid is opened.

The good looks are not enough to make me like this coffeemaker! Everything (coffee grounds and water) must be added from the top. This is all right when the coffeemaker is cold. However, if you open the top to add coffee for a second pot right after the first pot has brewed, the showerhead will send a cloud of steam straight into your face. (I strongly prefer a coffeemaker with an enclosed showerhead and a coffee basket that swings out sideways, like the slower-brewing [[ASIN:B0041A5H5S Hamilton Beach 12-Cup Digital Coffee Maker]].)

The lid on this Mr. Coffee coffeemaker has a second lid in the back half that flips up. I think this is intended for you to use in filling the reservoir, but the second lid doesn't always want to stay up. It's also faster to fill the reservoir by opening the entire lid. When you open the top, the entire mechanism with the showerhead feels flimsy, as if it will break easily (and early breakage has been my experience with this type of coffeemaker design).

The outer "removable filter basket" lacks a handle for easy removal. It has ear-like tabs that are hard to grip (especially if the coffeemaker is hot) and require using two hands to pull the basket up and out. If you're using the water filtration system, you will probably want to remove this outer basket for every pot, because you must put ground coffee (inside a paper or permanent filter) into the basket, and then place the water filtration system over the top of the basket. The water filtration system itself consists of a charcoal filter disk that slides into a frame or lid for the "removable filter basket".

The water filtration system is supposed to remove chlorine from your water, to make your coffee taste better. You need to change the charcoal filter every month. (The coffeemaker comes with just one filter.) This isn't very useful to me, because my tap water often tastes odd because of organic matter. Removing chlorine isn't enough, so I filter my coffee water with a different type of filter before adding it to the coffeemaker's water reservoir.

My coffeemaker arrived without either paper filters or the "Mr. Coffee nylon permanent filter" that is supposed to be included (according to the instructions). I guess that the permanent filter got removed in the warehouse, because the box wasn't completely sealed when it arrived. Some kind of additional filter is needed inside the "removable filter basket", or coffee grounds will escape into the carafe during brewing.

The coffeemaker comes with a short 26" cord, which is more or less standard for kitchen appliances now, especially heating appliances. The cord arrives coiled inside the coffeemaker's base, and needs to be pulled out when you first set up the coffeemaker.

Because of the many bad design features, I rate it this Mr. Coffee coffeemaker (Model BVMC-JPX37-AM) at 2 stars ("I don't like it" on the official Amazon scale).

product_metadata.title: Mr. Coffee 12-Cup Programmable Coffee Maker with Brew Strength Selector
features: Modern design with stainless steel accents
Grab-A-Cup Auto Pause stops cycle if you need a cup before brewing is finished
2-Hour Shut Off feature automatically turns off coffee maker, so you don't have to
Brew Strength Selector lets you choose your desired flavor intensity
description: The Mr. Coffee 12-Cup Programmable Automatic Coffee Maker brings style, taste, and functionality together to create a rich blend that you'll savor for years to come. It features plenty of programmable options, like Delay Brew for coffee when you want it, or Brew Strength Selector to dial in the perfect taste. It also features a removable filter basket that lifts out for easy filling and cleaning. As coffee brews and that heavenly aroma fills the air, you don't have to wait until the cycle finishes to savor a cup, thanks to the convenient Grab-A-Cup Auto Pause feature.
